task.description: Validate the ISS-106 code design artefact src/design/iss-106-webhook-outbox.md against the ISS-106 acceptance criteria in the backlog. Confirm: (1) every ISS-106 acceptance criterion maps to a design element; (2) no implementation code is embedded (prose design); (3) the migration is additive + idempotent (no DROP TABLE/DROP COLUMN), applies to every tenant schema, uses unqualified table names; (4) the status CHECK reconciliation includes a safe pre-CHECK data remap so the migration cannot fail on existing rows; (5) the (status,next_attempt_at) index is reconciled, not duplicated; (6) ISS-205 engine/dispatcher logic is correctly excluded from scope. Run python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/iss-106-webhook-outbox.md and confirm no BLOCKER/MAJOR.

result.summary: ISS-106 design artefact src/design/iss-106-webhook-outbox.md validated as WF-02 Step 1b hard gate. All eight contract columns map to concrete design elements (delivery_id via existing id PK alias, subscription_id/event_id/next_attempt_at/last_error/created_at already present per 010/023/025, attempt added additively in Step 1 with backfill from attempt_count in Step 2). The status domain (PENDING,DELIVERED,FAILED,RETRYING) is reconciled via a safe pre-CHECK remap (Step 3: pending->PENDING, success->DELIVERED, failed->FAILED, exhausted->FAILED) ordered strictly before the new CHECK (Step 4), so the migration cannot fail on existing legacy rows. The (status,next_attempt_at) worker-claim index reuses the existing idx_wd_status_next_attempt via CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS (Step 5), no duplication. Migration is additive and idempotent with no DROP TABLE/DROP COLUMN, unqualified table names for per-tenant search_path resolution. Keeping id as delivery_id and retaining attempt_count alongside the new attempt are sound additive choices that preserve the live dispatcher and ISS-205 code while satisfying the contract. ISS-205 (transactional outbox insert, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claim, back-off ladder, all Zig changes) is explicitly excluded in the Scope section. No implementation code is presented as a finished .sql file; SQL fragments appear only as a prose design contract. lint_design_artefact.py exits 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR.
